AND LEARNING OBJECTIVES FOR PRE FINAL EXAMINATION"},"content":{"type":"html","$t":"\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;A 75year old farmer presented with chief complaints of anuria since 3 days and generalized weakness since 15 days.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBased on history:-\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E1. What triggered the back pain to relapse again after having no complaints since 5 years after treating it conservatively?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E2. Was the anuria sudden or was it decreased urinary output which progressed to anuria?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E3. History of chronic alcoholism is present but the patient says he was abstaining alcohol since 1 year are his findings correlating with his said history.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E4. What investigations were done when he had back pain?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E5. What was the treatment given to him 5 years back for back pain?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBased on examination and investigation:-\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E1. What are the reasons for pallor and edema?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E2. What are the reasons for elevated urea levels in renal function tests?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E3. What are the reasons for elevated creatinine levels in renal function tests?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E4. What is the reason for low hemoglobin and increased neutrophils, lymphocytes?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E5. Ultrasonography findings point to which kidney pathology?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ELEARNING OBJECTIVES:-\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E1. Evaluating a patient for acute kidney injury\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E2. Interpreting a ultrasonography report and learning about various grades of RPD changes of kidney.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E3. Causes of acute kidney injury:- pre-renal, renal and post renal.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E4. Management options for AKI based on grading and clinical findings.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E5. Importance of salt retention in cases of AKI with serum electrolyte imbalances.\u003C\/p\u003E"},"link":[{"rel":"replies","type":"application/atom+xml","href":"https:\/\/82vivek.blogspot.com\/feeds\/22589701924640388\/comments\/default","title":"Post Comments"},{"rel":"replies","type":"text/html","href":"https:\/\/82vivek.blogspot.com\/2023\/12\/osce-for-pre-final-examination.html#comment-form","title":"0 Comments"},{"rel":"edit","type":"application/atom+xml","href":"https:\/\/www.blogger.com\/feeds\/2546840380338144689\/posts\/default\/22589701924640388"},{"rel":"self","type":"application/atom+xml","href":"https:\/\/www.blogger.com\/feeds\/2546840380338144689\/posts\/default\/22589701924640388"},{"rel":"alternate","type":"text/html","href":"https:\/\/82vivek.blogspot.com\/2023\/12\/osce-for-pre-final-examination.html","title":"OSCE AND LEARNING OBJECTIVES FOR PRE FINAL EXAMINATION"}],"author":[{"name":{"$t":"82 Vivek"},"uri":{"$t":"http:\/\/www.blogger.com\/profile\/08912240108130685422"},"email":{"$t":"noreply@blogger.com"},"gd$image":{"rel":"http://schemas.google.com/g/2005#thumbnail","width":"16","height":"16","src":"https:\/\/img1.blogblog.com\/img\/b16-rounded.gif"}}],"thr$total":{"$t":"0"}},{"id":{"$t":"tag:blogger.com,1999:blog-2546840380338144689.post-5564863918618152756"},"published":{"$t":"2023-11-30T19:22:00.000-08:00"},"updated":{"$t":"2023-11-30T19:22:18.897-08:00"},"title":{"type":"text","$t":"Ascites secondary to chronic liver disease."},"content":{"type":"html","$t":"\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003Cspan face=\"Roboto, sans-serif\" style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; background-color: white; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); color: #757575; font-family: verdana; font-size: 15px;\"\u003ETHIS IS AN ONLINE E LOGBOOK TO DISCUSS OUR PATIENT'S DE-IDENTIFIED HEALTH DATA SHARED AFTER TAKING HIS \/ HER \/GUARDIAN'S SIGNED INFORMED CONSENT.
